annotations.description: Additional annotations to add to all Kubernetes deployment resources

a2aBaseUrl.description: The base URL of the A2A Server endpoint, as advertised to clients.

a2aClientTimeout.description: HTTP client timeout for A2A requests from the controller to agent pods. 0 (the default) means no timeout, which is correct for SSE-based streaming agents that can run for an arbitrarily long time. The previous implicit default was 3m (inherited from the a2a-go SDK), which caused `context deadline exceeded` errors for agents that take longer than 3 minutes to complete. Set a positive Go duration string (e.g. "30m", "1h") only if you need a hard upper bound on individual A2A calls.

agentDeployment.description: Global deployment defaults applied to all agent pods. Per-agent settings in the Agent CRD take precedence over these defaults.

host.description: Default host address for agent pods to bind to. Leave empty to use the controller's default fallback of "0.0.0.0". Automatically set to "::" when ipv6.enabled is true. Can be explicitly overridden here regardless of the ipv6 flag.

nodeSelector.description: Default nodeSelector applied to all agent deployments. Useful when admission policies require a nodeSelector on every Deployment, since wizard-created Agents carry none. A per-agent nodeSelector in the Agent CRD takes precedence over these defaults.

podLabels.description: Default labels applied to all agent pod templates. Per-agent labels in the Agent CRD take precedence over these defaults.

serviceAccountName.description: Default ServiceAccount name for agent pods. When set, agent pods that don't specify an explicit serviceAccountName will use this ServiceAccount instead of creating a per-agent one. Useful for Workload Identity (GCP, AWS IRSA, Azure Workload Identity). Precedence: agent-level serviceAccountName > this default > auto-created SA.

pullSecret.description: Image pull secret name set on agent pods created by the controller

annotations.description: Additional annotations to add to the controller Deployment metadata

goAgentImage.description: The image used for the Go (ADK) runtime agent.

mcpEgressPlaintext.description: Rewrite RemoteMCPServer tool URLs and the controller's tool-discovery dial from `https://host[:port]` to `http://host:<port-or-443>` so MCP traffic egresses in plaintext to a proxy that originates TLS upstream off by default.

metrics.description: Prometheus-style /metrics endpoint for the controller manager. When enabled, provisions a dedicated metrics Service plus the ClusterRoles required for authenticated scrapes. Bind `<fullname>-metrics-reader` to your Prometheus ServiceAccount to grant scrape access. Use `bindAddress` for any port change: the Service `targetPort` and the pod `containerPort` are derived from it at template time, so overriding `METRICS_BIND_ADDRESS` via `controller.env` shifts only the runtime listener and leaves the rendered Service pointing at the chart-time port. Setting `bindAddress: "0"` (or empty) is treated as a disable signal — equivalent to `enabled: false` — to keep faith with the controller

pdb.description: [PodDisruptionBudget](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/) for the controller pods. Disabled by default: `controller.replicas` is 1, and a `minAvailable: 1` budget on a single-replica Deployment blocks every voluntary eviction, so node drains and cluster upgrades hang indefinitely. Raise `controller.replicas` before switching to `minAvailable`.

enabled.description: Set to true to create the PodDisruptionBudget.

labels.description: Additional labels for the controller PodDisruptionBudget.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number of pods that may be unavailable. Int or percentage string (e.g. `1` or `"50%"`). Mutually exclusive with `minAvailable`.

minAvailable.description: Minimum number of pods that must remain available. Int or percentage string (e.g. `1` or `"50%"`). Mutually exclusive with `maxUnavailable`.

unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy.description: `spec.unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy`, one of `IfHealthyBudget` (the Kubernetes default) or `AlwaysAllow`. `AlwaysAllow` lets unhealthy pods be evicted even when the budget is exhausted, which avoids drains wedging on a crash-looping pod. Requires Kubernetes >= 1.27. Omitted from the manifest when empty.

podLabels.description: Additional labels for the controller pod template, merged over the global `podLabels` (per-key; component keys win). Selector labels can never be overridden.

readinessProbe.description: Custom readiness probe for the controller container. Setting a value replaces the default probe entirely — include a handler (httpGet / exec / tcpSocket / grpc) when overriding.

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount settings for the controller pod

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the controller ServiceAccount. Useful for GCP Workload Identity, AWS IRSA, or Azure Workload Identity.

skillsInitImage.description: The image used by the skills-init container to clone skills from Git and pull OCI skill images.

startupProbe.description: Custom startup probe for the controller container. Setting a value replaces the default probe entirely — include a handler (httpGet / exec / tcpSocket / grpc) when overriding.

streaming.description: @deprecated Removed in 0.10.0. The A2A SDK now handles SSE buffering and timeouts internally. These values have no effect and will be removed in a future release.

tolerations.description: Node taints which will be tolerated for `Pod` [scheduling](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/).

toolRefreshInterval.description: How often MCP tool-discovery controllers requeue to refresh the discovered-tool cache (RemoteMCPServer, MCPServer, labeled MCP Service). Default 60s.

watchNamespaces.description: Namespaces the controller should watch. If empty, the controller will watch ALL available namespaces.

bundled.description: Bundled PostgreSQL instance — for development and evaluation only. Not suitable for production. Deployed when enabled is true and url/urlFile are not set.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable the bundled database and provide your own via url or urlFile.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context for the bundled PostgreSQL deployment.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the demo PostgreSQL container

securityContext.description: Container-level security context for the bundled PostgreSQL container.

storage.description: PersistentVolumeClaim size for demo PostgreSQL data

storageClassName.description: StorageClass for the PostgreSQL PVC. Defaults to the cluster default when empty.

pool.description: Optional pgxpool settings. Leave unset/null to keep pgx library defaults (MaxConns≈max(4,NumCPU), MinConns=0, MaxConnIdleTime=30m, MaxConnLifetime=1h).

sessionRetentionDays.description: Hard-delete idle sessions (and cascaded events/tasks/checkpoints/shares) after N days of no activity. Uses session.updated_at as a sliding idle clock (writes refresh it). 0 disables cleanup (default, existing installs unchanged).

skipMigrations.description: Skip running database migrations at controller startup. The controller instead verifies the database is already migrated and fails if it is not. Migrations must be applied out-of-band (e.g. from a CI/CD pipeline) before install/upgrade.

url.description: External PostgreSQL connection string. Is always used if set regardless of the `.bundled.enabled` field.

urlFile.description: Path to a file containing the database URL. Takes precedence over url when set. Is always used if set regardless of the `.bundled.enabled` field.

vectorEnabled.description: Enable the pgvector migration Required to use features that depend on database vector capability. (e.g. long-term memory) Set to true when using an external PostgreSQL that has the pgvector extension installed.

extraObjects.description: Additional arbitrary Kubernetes manifests to deploy alongside the chart. Each list entry is rendered through `tpl`, so values may reference the release context (e.g. `{{ include "kagent.fullname" . }}`, `{{ .Release.Namespace }}`). Both map and multi-line string entries are supported. Use this to manage resources such as ExternalSecret, HTTPRoute, or NetworkPolicy within the same chart lifecycle without maintaining a separate chart.  To use, replace the empty list below with your manifests, e.g.: extraObjects: - apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1 kind: ExternalSecret metadata: name: '{{ include "kagent.fullname" . }}-openai' namespace: '{{ .Release.Namespace }}' spec: secretStoreRef: name: aws-secretsmanager kind: ClusterSecretStore target: name: kagent-openai data: - secretKey: OPENAI_API_KEY remoteRef: key: prod/kagent/openai property: api_key

global.description: Global values shared between all subcharts
global.$comment: Added automatically by 'helm schema' to allow this chart to be used as a Helm dependency, as the `additionalProperties` setting would otherwise collide with Helm's special 'global' values key.

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6/dual-stack support. When true, configures all components for dual-stack (IPv4+IPv6) networking: - nginx listens on both IPv4 and IPv6 (adds `listen [::]:8080`) - Next.js binds to `::` instead of `0.0.0.0` - Agent pods bind to `::` for dual-stack reachability Leave disabled on clusters where IPv6 is disabled at the kernel level.

tolerations.description: Node taints which will be tolerated for `Pod` [scheduling](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/).

labels.description: Additional labels to add to all Kubernetes resources

podLabels.description: Additional labels to add to all pod templates (merged into pod labels of the controller and UI Deployments; can be overridden per component). Useful for admission policies that require specific labels on pods.

annotations.description: Annotations added to the metadata of the generated default ModelConfig (the one derived from `providers.default`). Omitted from the resource when empty.

namespaces.description: Namespaces in which to create Role and RoleBinding resources. If empty (default), the chart creates cluster-scoped ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding resources and the controller watches all namespaces. If set, the chart creates a Role + RoleBinding per listed namespace and the controller's WATCH_NAMESPACES is derived from this list (unless controller.watchNamespaces is set explicitly, which always takes precedence).

substrateWorkerPool.description: Optional Agent Substrate WorkerPool installed by this chart. This is platform capacity and is not owned by individual AgentHarness resources.

tolerations.description: Node taints which will be tolerated for `Pod` [scheduling](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/).

additionalForwardedHeaders.description: Additional request headers (beyond Authorization) the UI proxy will forward to the backend. Names are case-insensitive. Hop-by-hop headers (Connection, Transfer-Encoding, etc.) are silently dropped.

annotations.description: Additional annotations to add to the UI Deployment metadata

externalUrl.description: Public-facing base URL of the UI (e.g. https://kagent.example.com). When set, the controller injects KAGENT_UI_URL into agent pods so that share link tools return full clickable URLs instead of relative paths.

httpRoute.description: Gateway API `HTTPRoute` for the UI. Requires the Gateway API CRDs (`gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1`) and an existing `Gateway` to attach to via `parentRefs`. Disabled by default; enable to front the UI with a Gateway API implementation (kgateway, Istio, Envoy Gateway, etc.) instead of the OpenShift Route or bundled oauth2-proxy.

labels.description: Extra labels to add to the `HTTPRoute` (merged with the chart labels).

parentRefs.description: Gateways this route attaches to. Required when `enabled` is `true`.

rules.description: Routing rules. When a rule omits `backendRefs`, it defaults to the UI `Service` on `ui.service.ports.port`. Each rule may also set `matches`, `filters`, and `timeouts`.

nginx.description: Nginx proxy timeout configuration for the UI sidecar (values are passed directly to the corresponding nginx directives, e.g. "1800s").

proxyReadTimeout.description: proxy_read_timeout: max time between two successive reads from the upstream.

proxySendTimeout.description: proxy_send_timeout: max time between two successive writes to the upstream.

pdb.description: [PodDisruptionBudget](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/) for the UI pods. Disabled by default: `ui.replicas` is 1, and a `minAvailable: 1` budget on a single-replica Deployment blocks every voluntary eviction, so node drains and cluster upgrades hang indefinitely. Raise `ui.replicas` before switching to `minAvailable`.

enabled.description: Set to true to create the PodDisruptionBudget.

labels.description: Additional labels for the UI PodDisruptionBudget.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number of pods that may be unavailable. Int or percentage string (e.g. `1` or `"50%"`). Mutually exclusive with `minAvailable`.

minAvailable.description: Minimum number of pods that must remain available. Int or percentage string (e.g. `1` or `"50%"`). Mutually exclusive with `maxUnavailable`.

unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy.description: `spec.unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy`, one of `IfHealthyBudget` (the Kubernetes default) or `AlwaysAllow`. `AlwaysAllow` lets unhealthy pods be evicted even when the budget is exhausted, which avoids drains wedging on a crash-looping pod. Requires Kubernetes >= 1.27. Omitted from the manifest when empty.

podLabels.description: Additional labels for the UI pod template, merged over the global `podLabels` (per-key; component keys win). Selector labels can never be overridden.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context for the UI pod. Overrides the global podSecurityContext.

readinessProbe.description: Custom readiness probe for the UI container. Override to adjust thresholds, use exec-based probes, or change the health path.

route.description: Gates the OpenShift `Route` for the UI. Additionally conditional on the `route.openshift.io/v1` API being present, so it is a no-op off-OpenShift. Set to `false` to front the UI with your own Route/ingress or the bundled oauth2-proxy instead of the chart's edge-terminated Route.

securityContext.description: Container-level security context for the UI container. Overrides the global securityContext.

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount settings for the UI pod

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the UI ServiceAccount. Useful for GCP Workload Identity, AWS IRSA, or Azure Workload Identity.

startupProbe.description: Custom startup probe for the UI container. Override to adjust thresholds, use exec-based probes, or change the health path.

streamTimeoutSeconds.description: Client-side chat stream inactivity timeout (seconds). The browser aborts a streaming response if no event is received within this window. Should be >= ui.nginx.proxyReadTimeout so nginx isn't the silent limit. Default 1800 (30m).

tolerations.description: Node taints which will be tolerated for `Pod` [scheduling](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/).

volumes.description: EmptyDir volume sizes for Next.js UI workload (typically used when enabling readOnlyRootFilesystem)

nextjsCache.description: Size limit for Next.js build cache (.next/cache). Default 100Mi is sufficient for typical Next.js apps with moderate caching needs.

tmp.description: Size limit for temporary files (/tmp). Default 50Mi provides ample space for Next.js runtime temporary data.
